en.headline: Customs seize three live cats at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line, arrest woman
en.dek: A 68-year-old mainland passenger was intercepted in the arrival hall with the animals in her luggage; the cats are valued at about HK$36,000 and the case has been referred to the AFCD.
body: Hong Kong Customs officers at the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line Control Point on Thursday intercepted a 68-year-old incoming mainland female passenger in the arrival hall. Three live cats suspected of being illegally imported were found in her personal luggage.

The estimated market value of the animals is about HK$36,000. The passenger was arrested and the case has been handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up investigation.

Customs reminded the public that importing animals into Hong Kong without a valid permit is an offence under the Rabies Regulation, carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$50,000 fine and one year’s imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢3隻懷疑非法進口活貓 拘68歲女
zh.dek: 關員在入境大堂截查一名抵港內地女旅客，於行李內發現3隻活貓，估計市值約3.6萬元，案件交漁護署跟進。
body: 香港海關周四在落馬洲支線管制站入境大堂截查一名68歲抵港內地女旅客，在其個人行李內檢獲3隻懷疑非法進口的活貓。
3隻活貓估計市值共約3.6萬元。該名旅客隨即被捕，案件已轉交漁護署跟進調查。
海關提醒市民，任何人未領有有效許可證而將動物輸入香港，即屬違法。根據《狂犬病規例》，最高可被罰款5萬元及監禁一年。
